tasks.title: Allocate Capital Call No. 4 to the partners
tasks.instructions: In Capital Calls/Capital Call 4 Notice.xlsx, fill in the Call Amount column (Allocation!E6:E17): each partner's share is its Commitment % multiplied by the Total capital call on the Call Summary sheet, rounded to the cent (for example =ROUND(D6*'Call Summary'!$C$12,2)). The Difference cell (Allocation!E21) must be 0. Save the workbook.

tasks.title: Reconcile the September 2026 operating account
tasks.instructions: In Accounting/Bank Reconciliation Sep 2026.xlsx, compare the GL Cash sheet with the Bank Statement sheet and clear the difference on the Reconciliation sheet: (1) correct the GL entry that was posted with the wrong amount (the bank statement is right); (2) list the check that has not cleared the bank under "Less: outstanding checks" (Reconciliation!B9:C9); (3) record the bank credit and the bank charge that are missing from the GL under the two "not recorded in the GL" sections (B15:C15 and B18:C18). Enter amounts as positive numbers. Reconciliation!C22 (Difference) must be 0. Save the workbook.

tasks.title: Calculate the Q4 2026 management fee
tasks.instructions: In Accounting/Q4 2026 Management Fee.xlsx (sheet Fee Calc): enter the number of days in the quarter in C8 (quarter start and end both count); compute the quarterly fee in C10 as fee-paying commitments × annual rate × days ÷ 365, rounded to the cent; and fill each partner's Q4 2026 Fee in F13:F24 the same way on its own commitment (0 for a partner that is not fee-paying). Save the workbook.

tasks.title: Fix the Q3 2026 capital account roll-forward
tasks.instructions: In Investor Reporting/Capital Account Statements Q3 2026.xlsx, every partner's Ending Balance (Roll-forward!I6:I17) must equal Beginning + Contributions − Distributions − Management Fees + Realized + Unrealized. Two rows do not follow that rule; fix them so the Difference against the Fund Summary (Roll-forward!I21) is 0. Save the workbook.
